egp.posting.success.prepared: The packet of {kind} {code} is prepared; another person posts it.
egp.posting.success.receipted: Receipt {ref} recorded for {kind} {code}; the duty is closed.
egp.posting.success.rejected: Recorded that the network rejected {kind} {code}; it must be prepared again.

egp.posting.success.swept: Opened {opened} new duties, {existing} were there already (counted from {since}).
